lines.trans: To our media colleagues in the hall and all viewers watching the live broadcast, hello everyone.
Welcome to the official press conference for Season Three of Twelve Singers.
With your warmest applause, please welcome the Golden Class alongside pop diva Xin Huimei!
Season Three of Twelve Singers premieres next month, featuring a brand-new revamped competition format.
Members of the press, the floor is now open for your questions.
Actually, I already know what everyone in the room wants to ask.
Up until a few days ago I really was single — not in any relationship, and certainly never married.
Today, however, things have changed.
Then who is your boyfriend?!
Allow me to proudly introduce my boyfriend — Xingtian Entertainment's chief content officer, Mr Chun Yuqiao.
With this bombshell romance announcement, the earlier secret-marriage rumors have been proven false.
Her boyfriend is none other than genius producer Chun Yuqiao, stepping before the public media together.
